description: This file defines the Calendar entity class used in the Fineract project, representing a calendar for scheduling events with various attributes such as title, description, dates, recurrence, and reminders. It includes methods for creating, updating, and validating calendar instances, as well as handling recurrence rules and date constraints.

classes.name: Calendar
classes.description: Entity class representing a calendar schedule with support for recurrence, reminders, and date validation within the Fineract system.

methods.name: createRepeatingCalendar
methods.description: Static factory method to create a repeating calendar with specified recurrence details.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Static factory method to instantiate a Calendar object from JSON command parameters.

methods.name: updateStartDateAndDerivedFeilds
methods.description: Updates start date and recalculates recurrence if necessary, returning the changes made.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates calendar attributes based on JSON command input, with validation and recurrence adjustments.

methods.name: updateRepeatingCalendar
methods.description: Updates the start date and recurrence rule for a repeating calendar.

methods.description: Returns the duration of the calendar event.
